title: 48 Times People Accidentally Texted The Wrong Person And Made Their Day (New Pics)
desc: Most of us have been here: you check your phone, only to see that you’ve gotten a text message from a complete stranger. Often, they’re scammers and spammers. Other times, they are random people who simply mixed up the phone number and got in touch with you instead. ‘Wrong Number’ is a bizarre and relatable online group where people share screenshots of the weird and sometimes weirdly hilarious text conversations they’ve had with folks they don’t know. We’re featuring the best ones. Don’t forget to send these to a friend… or get the number wrong on purpose and make a stranger’s day instead. . Fails, Funny
